roster.name: Dublin Core Metadata Element Set, Version 1.1 (the fifteen-element Dublin Core)
roster.description: A small core vocabulary of fifteen broad, generic metadata properties (e.g., Title, Creator, Subject, Date, Identifier) for describing resources. This is a legacy/reference specification (dc: namespace) documenting the original 15-element Dublin Core used for resource discovery and interoperability; the seed document is explicitly the 1.1 reference description.

roster.name: DCMI Metadata Terms (DCTERMS)
roster.description: The broader DCMI vocabulary set that includes semantically richer versions of Dublin Core properties (dcterms: namespace), resource classes (DCMI Type), vocabulary encoding/syntax schemes, and formal domains/ranges; used for more precise machine-processable metadata and for creating application profiles based on the DCMI Abstract Model (DCAM).
